protocol.maxRSS_unit: MiB; OS process high-water mark including Node/V8, code, initialization and query loops
protocol.initialization: compile literal tool + load data/decoder/prefix catalog; excludes filesystem read
protocol.first_query: lookup + output serialization, includes lazy term/shard decoding
protocol.cold_total: initialization + first query; no cross-call cache assumed
protocol.warm: same initialized local VM; informational, not a guarantee of n8n reuse
protocol.comparison: exact full serialized response SHA-256 per case; no model outputs
